components.css: .ds-result{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#202b26);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d5ddd7);padding:28px 0}.ds-source{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted,#58665e)}.ds-source span:first-child{font-weight:650;color:var(--ink,#202b26)}.ds-rank{margin-left:auto;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-result h2{font-size:21px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35;margin:8px 0 9px;letter-spacing:-.015em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-result h2 a{color:var(--accent,#1d6454);text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:.22em}.ds-result h2 a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-result a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1d6454);outline-offset:4px}.ds-excerpt{font-size:15px;line-height:1.65;margin:0;max-width:72ch;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-result-footer{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px 16px;margin-top:12px;align-items:baseline;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#58665e)}.ds-result-footer>span{line-height:1.8}.ds-result-footer a{color:inherit;text-decoration-color:#a8b8ae;text-underline-offset:.22em}.ds-text-button{border:0;padding:6px 0;background:none;color:var(--accent,#1d6454);font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-text-button:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-text-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1d6454);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-result a,.ds-text-button{transition:color 120ms,background-color 120ms}}

narrative.overview:
Trace puts source titles and readable excerpts beside optional ranking evidence. The interface uses neutral backgrounds, muted teal actions, thin separators, and native form controls. Search and Inspect share the same typography and spacing.

These rules describe the implemented Phase 2 interface in `web/style.css` and `web/app.tsx`. Product facts belong in `PRODUCT.md`; the search composition belongs in `.impeccable/surfaces/search.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral backgrounds and muted teal actions
dos: Do keep source titles and excerpts readable before exposing engine details.
Do preserve source links and attribution.
Do use monospace for analyzed query terms and term evidence. Use tabular numerals for other measurements.
Do obtain scores, counters, and timing values from the server trace.
donts: Don't reconstruct ranking values in the interface.
Don't turn request timings into benchmark claims.
Don't add later-phase controls before their engine behavior exists.
